findings.text: blocking: The summary at :85-86 disagrees on seven but reads 'three diverted slices (0, 14, 456) as limited, and four limited slices (118, 206) as diverted', while the receipt /tmp/tcvk/all.json and this report's own table at :66-77 carry 5 diverted->limited (0, 14, 456, 796, 1257) and 2 limited->diverted (118, 206); the counts reconcile with neither the parenthetical lists (3 and 2 items) nor the total of seven, so the delivered summary misstates the structure of its own result.

follow-on: The fragment caption enumerates only 5 of the 7 disagreements ('three diverted slices (0, 14, 456)' and 'two limited slices (118, 206)'), omitting 796 and 1257, which /tmp/tcvk/all.json and the report table both label diverted->limited; the figure caption at docs/research/tcv-liuqe-known-answer.html:123-126 omits the same two.

follow-on: The zero-saddle fix was applied to measure_slice, which re-implements the decision loop the repository already owns at scripts/prototypes/efit_field_swap/crosscheck.py:349-417; crosscheck._decision still refuses a zero-saddle slice at crosscheck.py:372, so the two copies now diverge on exactly the limited slices this node set out to score, and the brief named efit_field_swap as the place to extend.

follow-on: read_wall (figures.py:40-51) and slice_view (figures.py:54-73) duplicate the same two helpers at measure.py:77-89 and measure.py:101-132 within the one node, so the wall-IDS-to-rings reading exists twice and will drift.

follow-on: axes.set_xlabel('R [m]') and set_ylabel('Z [m]') are called on a panel whose axis nova.media.ink.poloidal_axes:165 turns off with set_axis_off(), so neither label can render; the panel carries no 2D axes by the plotting rule, so these two calls are dead.

follow-on: baseline_suite and after_suite are recorded as free-text 'not run' rather than the required single-line JSON with a command and log_path, and /tmp/tcvk/gate.log carries no header naming the revision, tree or command it ran at, so the focused gate's provenance cannot be reconstructed from the log.
